verdict.rationale: A live probe shows Render serves a machine-readable OpenAPI spec at https://render.com/openapi.json (HTTP 200, contains an "openapi" key), and the docs list a REST API, so the story is directly delivered. Missing for 10: first-party docs that describe or link the downloadable spec, and evidence of how completely the spec covers the REST API and how it is versioned.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: PROBE openapi: HTTP 200 at https://render.com/openapi.json — contains "openapi" key
